facts.statement: Sinopliosaurus is a dubious genus of pliosauroid plesiosaur.
facts.quote: Sinopliosaurus (meaning "Chinese more lizard") is a dubious genus of pliosauroid plesiosaur.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of three vertebrae and a tooth found in the Lianmugin Formation.
facts.quote: The holotype, IVPP V140, consists of three vertebrae and a tooth, discovered in a layer of the Lianmugin Formation (Tugulu Group).

facts.statement: Sinopliosaurus lived during the Aptian and Albian stages of the Early Cretaceous in China, though some remains are disputedly dated to the Toarcian age.
facts.quote: It lived during the Aptian and Albian stages of the Early Cretaceous (disputed Sinopliosaurus remains have been dated to the Toarcian age and were found in the Ziliujing Formation) of the People's Republic of China

facts.statement: Sinopliosaurus weiyuanensis was considered to be a freshwater plesiosaur.
facts.quote: S. weiyuanensis was considered as a freshwater plesiosaur.

facts.statement: The species Sinopliosaurus fusuiensis was later identified as teeth belonging to the spinosaurid dinosaur Siamosaurus.
facts.quote: One species, "S." fusuiensis, was later shown to be based on teeth from a spinosaurid theropod dinosaur which is now known as Siamosaurus.

facts.statement: Sinopliosaurus belongs to the order Plesiosauria.
Sinopliosaurus is classified within the suborder Pliosauroidea.
In 2008, researchers reclassified Sinopliosaurus fusuiensis as a spinosaurid relative to Siamosaurus.
facts.quote: Sinopliosaurus fusuiensis, descrito originalmente como un Sauropterygia, en 2008, Buffetaut, E., Suteethorn, V., Tong, H. & Amiot, R., lo han descrito como un espinosáurido pariente del Siamosaurus de Tailandia.

facts.statement: The parent group for Sinopliosaurus is the family Pliosauridae.
The recorded time range for Sinopliosaurus spans from the Toarcian to the Tithonian, between 184.2 and 143.1 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Toarcian to Tithonian (184.2 to 143.1 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The type species Sinopliosaurus weiyuanensis was named and described in 1944 by Yang Zhongjian.
rejected.quote: The type species, Sinopliosaurus weiyuanensis, was named and described in 1944 by Yang Zhongjian.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'type species Sinopliosaurus weiyuanensis was named and described'
